query: select i.BillingCountry as country, round(sum(l.UnitPrice*l.Quantity),2) as revenue from InvoiceLine l join Invoice i using(InvoiceId) join Track t using(TrackId) join Genre g using(GenreId) where (${year} is null or substr(i.InvoiceDate,1,4) = ${year}) and (${genre} is null or g.Name = ${genre}) group by 1 order by 2 desc
